# avahi / fuzz-ini-file-parser

avahi's own fuzz target `fuzz-ini-file-parser` ([source](source/fuzz-ini-file-parser.c), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over avahi (avahi/avahi at b1a83592).

avahi_ini_file_load on the temp file, then avahi_split_csv on every value; all output goes to a no-op log function.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against avahi at commit b1a83592.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- environment sanity only: mkstemp returned a descriptor and write() wrote all bytes of the temp file; not a property of the INI parser ([lines 39-43](source/fuzz-ini-file-parser.c#L39-L43)): assert(); confirmed in the binary.

A failed check marked as ending the process contradicts every halts statement below, so a proof of one implies it on every input it covers.
